mapper.sql: t.*, st.name AS store_name, w.name AS warehouse_name, a.name AS cash_account_name, sh.shift_no AS open_shift_no, u.nickname AS open_cashier_name

LEFT JOIN store_info st ON st.id = t.store_id LEFT JOIN wms_warehouse w ON w.id = t.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN fin_account a ON a.id = t.cash_account_id LEFT JOIN pos_shift sh ON sh.terminal_id = t.id AND sh.status = 'OPEN' LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = sh.cashier_id
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM pos_terminal WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT s.material_id AS "materialId", SUM(s.qty - s.frozen_qty) AS "qty" FROM wms_stock s WHERE s.warehouse_id = #{warehouseId} AND s.material_id IN #{id} GROUP BY s.material_id
